disclaimer: Tarot archetypes are used here as prompts for reflection, not as validated psychological assessments or predictions. Personal patterns remain unverified unless the user independently confirms them.

archetypes.name: Magician
archetypes.interpretation: A possible tendency to take over relationship decisions.
archetypes.reflection_question: Do I leave room for mutual decisions?
archetypes.suggested_action: Invite the other person to share preferences and make one decision together.
qa_rules: Do not equate confidence with controlling behavior.
Do not predict when or whether the user will meet a true partner.

archetypes.name: High Priestess
archetypes.interpretation: A possible tendency to keep feelings private.
archetypes.reflection_question: Do I communicate my needs clearly?
archetypes.suggested_action: Express one relationship need directly and respectfully.
qa_rules: Do not assume privacy or silence proves emotional avoidance.
Do not predict when or whether the user will meet a true partner.

archetypes.name: Empress
archetypes.interpretation: A possible tendency to give more care than one asks for in return.
archetypes.reflection_question: Do I make room for my own needs as well as others' needs?
archetypes.suggested_action: Write down what I give and what support I need.
qa_rules: Do not portray generosity as weakness.
Do not predict when or whether the user will meet a true partner.

archetypes.name: Emperor
archetypes.interpretation: A possible tendency to rely on rigid rules or expectations.
archetypes.reflection_question: Which standards are essential, and which are preferences?
archetypes.suggested_action: List three non-negotiables and three flexible preferences.
qa_rules: Do not advise abandoning healthy boundaries.
Do not predict when or whether the user will meet a true partner.

archetypes.name: Hierophant
archetypes.interpretation: A possible tendency to follow inherited or fixed beliefs about relationships.
archetypes.reflection_question: Which beliefs reflect my values, and which have I adopted from others?
archetypes.suggested_action: Review one relationship belief and where it came from.
qa_rules: Do not assume cultural or family values are inherently harmful.
Do not predict when or whether the user will meet a true partner.

archetypes.name: Lovers
archetypes.interpretation: A possible tension between attraction, values, and choices.
archetypes.reflection_question: Do my choices align with my relationship values?
archetypes.suggested_action: Compare attraction, compatibility, respect, and shared values separately.
qa_rules: Do not make a relationship decision based on a card alone.
Do not predict when or whether the user will meet a true partner.

archetypes.name: Chariot
archetypes.interpretation: A possible tendency to prioritize goals over relationship-building time.
archetypes.reflection_question: Am I making time for the kind of connection I want?
archetypes.suggested_action: Choose one realistic opportunity to meet or connect with people.
qa_rules: Do not frame career ambition as a flaw.
Do not predict when or whether the user will meet a true partner.

archetypes.name: Justice
archetypes.interpretation: A possible tendency to over-evaluate a potential partner.
archetypes.reflection_question: Am I assessing real compatibility or expecting perfection?
archetypes.suggested_action: Separate essential needs from ordinary human imperfections.
qa_rules: Do not encourage tolerating unfair or harmful treatment.
Do not predict when or whether the user will meet a true partner.

archetypes.name: Hermit
archetypes.interpretation: A possible preference for solitude or a smaller social world.
archetypes.reflection_question: Is solitude a chosen need, or is it limiting connection I want?
archetypes.suggested_action: Try one low-pressure social activity that fits my comfort level.
qa_rules: Do not treat being single or solitary as a problem.
Do not predict when or whether the user will meet a true partner.

archetypes.name: Wheel of Fortune
archetypes.interpretation: A possible recurring on-and-off relationship pattern.
archetypes.reflection_question: Do similar relationship situations repeat, and what actually happens?
archetypes.suggested_action: Record events, responses, and outcomes without assuming fate caused them.
qa_rules: Do not claim destiny determines relationship outcomes.
Do not predict when or whether the user will meet a true partner.

archetypes.name: Strength
archetypes.interpretation: A possible difficulty showing vulnerability or asking for support.
archetypes.reflection_question: Can I express a need when I do not feel strong?
archetypes.suggested_action: Share one feeling or request with a trusted person.
qa_rules: Do not shame resilience or imply that strength prevents love.
Do not predict when or whether the user will meet a true partner.

archetypes.name: Hanged Man
archetypes.interpretation: A possible tendency to wait without taking an available step.
archetypes.reflection_question: What is within my control while I wait?
archetypes.suggested_action: Identify one small action I can choose without pressuring anyone.
qa_rules: Acknowledge that waiting can sometimes be appropriate.
Do not predict when or whether the user will meet a true partner.

archetypes.name: Death
archetypes.interpretation: A possible need to reflect on a past relationship transition.
archetypes.reflection_question: Am I comparing new connections with an old relationship?
archetypes.suggested_action: Write what I learned, what I want to keep, and what I want to release.
qa_rules: Do not demand that someone quickly forget or disclose their past.
Do not predict when or whether the user will meet a true partner.

archetypes.name: Temperance
archetypes.interpretation: A possible tendency to hide dissatisfaction to preserve peace.
archetypes.reflection_question: Do I voice concerns respectfully when something matters to me?
archetypes.suggested_action: Use an 'I feel / I need' statement for one concern.
qa_rules: Do not equate harmony with always sacrificing one's needs.
Do not predict when or whether the user will meet a true partner.

archetypes.name: Devil
archetypes.interpretation: A prompt to distinguish intense chemistry from healthy compatibility.
archetypes.reflection_question: Do respect, consistency, and boundaries accompany the attraction?
archetypes.suggested_action: Review observed behavior as well as chemistry.
qa_rules: Do not diagnose addiction or attachment problems from a card.
Do not predict when or whether the user will meet a true partner.

archetypes.name: Tower
archetypes.interpretation: A possible difficulty rebuilding trust after disappointment.
archetypes.reflection_question: Am I responding to current evidence or only to a past experience?
archetypes.suggested_action: Build trust gradually and notice consistent behavior over time.
qa_rules: Respect safety concerns; do not pressure trust or disclosure.
Do not predict when or whether the user will meet a true partner.

archetypes.name: Star
archetypes.interpretation: A possible tendency to idealize a future partner.
archetypes.reflection_question: Am I seeing the person as they are or as I hope they will be?
archetypes.suggested_action: Compare ideal qualities with practical compatibility needs.
qa_rules: Do not portray hope or standards as inherently bad.
Do not predict when or whether the user will meet a true partner.

archetypes.name: Moon
archetypes.interpretation: A prompt to separate uncertainty, fear, and assumptions from known facts.
archetypes.reflection_question: What do I know, what am I assuming, and what remains unknown?
archetypes.suggested_action: Write facts and assumptions separately; ask respectfully when appropriate.
qa_rules: Do not present guesses about another person's intent as facts.
Do not predict when or whether the user will meet a true partner.

archetypes.name: Sun
archetypes.interpretation: A possible expectation that a relationship should feel positive all the time.
archetypes.reflection_question: Can I handle ordinary disagreement while maintaining respect?
archetypes.suggested_action: Prioritize honesty, respect, repair, and consistency over perfection.
qa_rules: Do not force positivity or minimize real problems.
Do not predict when or whether the user will meet a true partner.

archetypes.name: Judgement
archetypes.interpretation: A prompt to review past experiences and choose what to do differently.
archetypes.reflection_question: What have past relationships taught me about my needs and choices?
archetypes.suggested_action: Choose one lesson and one behavior to practice next time.
qa_rules: Do not blame or shame the user for past relationships.
Do not predict when or whether the user will meet a true partner.

archetypes.name: World
archetypes.interpretation: A possible focus on other life goals at this stage.
archetypes.reflection_question: Do I want a relationship now, and what capacity do I have for one?
archetypes.suggested_action: Clarify current priorities and whether to make room for dating.
qa_rules: Do not imply a person is incomplete without a partner.
Do not predict when or whether the user will meet a true partner.

archetypes.name: Fool
archetypes.interpretation: A prompt to explore how freedom and commitment could coexist.
archetypes.reflection_question: What does commitment mean to me, and what freedom do I need?
archetypes.suggested_action: Define personal space and shared expectations in a conversation.
qa_rules: Do not assume non-commitment is fear or a defect.
Do not predict when or whether the user will meet a true partner.
